extracted.intended_audience: fiction writers (novelists, short-story writers) preparing/plotting stories
extracted.subtask_description: A collection of 25 distinct methods and techniques for plotting, planning, and prepping a story, aimed at helping fiction writers choose approaches to structure, discover voice, and organize material before or during drafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Basic Vanilla Outline
rubrics_metrics.description: Numbered/lettered outline by sections or acts.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Reverse Outline
rubrics_metrics.description: Begin with the ending; work backwards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mind-Maps
rubrics_metrics.description: Bubbles/spokes connecting to a central hub.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zero Draft
rubrics_metrics.description: "Puke up the story" without quality concerns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A rough, messy full-draft approach intended to spill out the story before revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: In The Document, As You Go
rubrics_metrics.description: Outline the next section before proceeding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write A Script
rubrics_metrics.description: Draft a screenplay-style version to move quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dialogue Pass
rubrics_metrics.description: Let characters talk in isolation to discover voices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index Cards
rubrics_metrics.description: Organize on individual cards arranged visually.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Crazy Person's Notebook
rubrics_metrics.description: Handwrite messy notes; tape into a journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collage
rubrics_metrics.description: Assemble images and quotes for mood.

rubrics_metrics.name: Story Bible
rubrics_metrics.description: Worldbuilding, characters, rules, plot, theme, mood compiled.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Power Of Templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Use established templates such as Save the Cat, Hero's Journey.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Test Drive
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write a separate, non-final piece to experiment with tone, POV, or character voice before committing to the main work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pants The Shit Out Of It
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An extreme 'seat-of-the-pants' approach emphasizing discovery through writing rather than pre-planning.
